arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import uuid

TZ = ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")
cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

event = Event()
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("description", "Weekly team meeting")
event.add("dtstart", datetime(2026, 8, 5, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))
event.add("dtend", datetime(2026, 8, 5, 16, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ))
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(ZoneInfo("UTC")))
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local")
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)

alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

with open("team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print("Created team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics")
EOF
